name: Self-order mobile order status screen
describe: Order confirmation: centred column (py-8), "Order confirmed" (text-xl semibold), thanks line, order/bill status rows (max-w-xs), optional open service requests, "Add more items" and "Done".
Shown after the order is submitted. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
